title: Icosahedral Cores in Golden Rhombohedra: Scutoid-Frusta Cells for the Ammann–Kramer–Neri Tiling

subjects.term: MSC2020 52C23: Quasicrystals and aperiodic tilings in discrete geometry

description:
We prove that icosahedral cores can be set in the never-repeating 3D Penrose tiling by the two golden rhombohedra (the Ammann–Kramer–Neri tiling) with the resin between core and cell cut entirely into Scutoid-Frusta (our geometric formalisation; not the biological scutoids of Gómez-Gálvez et al. (2018) [8], whom we credit). Put one core at the centre of every rhombohedron, all cores the same size and the same way up. Main theorem (Theorem 1, exact in ℚ(√5)): for the Rollerball, DICTO's combined method gives a valid division of the resin of every cell, prolate and oblate, in all 20 orientations that occur; all 72 pieces of each cell are Scutoid-Frusta, with 30 Y-vertices per cell, in 8 kinds per cell type. No kind of piece occurs in both cell types, so the cells can be read back from the pieces. Every tiling of the class has no period; the tiling built here has no symmetry other than the identity, and its Scutoid-Frusta layer has the same. The layer follows the tiling piece by piece: it never repeats, and it carries the tiling's order one to one, prolate to oblate in the golden ratio φ. Four further cores (Fullerene Star, icosidodecahedron, icosahedron, dodecahedron) give valid divisions as well, with fewer Scutoid-Frusta or none (Proposition 4). The second result (Theorem 3, exact) is a seam obstruction. In the cut-and-project tilings, across a wall shared by two cells of the same type the two cut patterns line up exactly, because the two cores are mirror images in the wall, every wall being perpendicular to a two-fold axis of the core. Across every prolate–oblate wall they do not, in every face-to-face tiling by the two rhombohedra. No placement of the cores makes every pair of neighbours mirror images: 552 of the 814 interior edges of the patch are surrounded by an odd number of cells, and the conditions they impose have no common solution. That mirror placement is the only way to line up two Voronoi patterns of this kind is argued, not proved. The cores sit in a never-repeating pattern and every piece is a Scutoid-Frustum; whether the pieces can also meet edge to edge across every wall is open.

Computation, proofs, verification and drafting with Claude (Anthropic).
